about: The illustrated deck of mods/cards, drawn by ElevenLabs (gpt-image-2, 1280x720, one generation each): the figures, the suit emblems, the back, then each 1..7 as a whole picture (<value>_<suit>). The free plan stops after a few images a day: every day generate the ones not done, save each as ~/kart_assets/cards/elevenlabs/<name>.png, set done, then run tools/make_cards.py and the models (tools/make_card_models.py in Blender). A card whose art is missing is drawn from the Blender art meanwhile.

images.name: fante_denari
images.prompt: Artwork for the face of a traditional Neapolitan (Napoletane) playing card: the JACK of COINS (Fante di Denari). A young page with a feathered cap and a green and red short tunic and hose, standing, full figure, holding one large round golden coin with a sun-like ornament in one hand. Style: classic 19th-century Italian woodcut card art, flat bright colours (red, blue, yellow, green) with bold black outlines, simple shading. Plain cream background, no border, no frame, no text, no numbers, no letters. Portrait composition, figure centred filling the height.
